events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The conflict in Iran continues to escalate, with the US and its allies involved. This has led to increased tensions in the region and a rise in oil prices. The situation is highly volatile and could lead to further escalation.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the conflict in Iran has led to increased tensions in the region, which could lead to further escalation and a rise in oil prices. This makes it a good time to buy the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) and short the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO).

events.exitStrategy: Exit the position if the conflict de-escalates or if the oil prices drop significantly
